{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "neg_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Count of negative lexicon words in the review text; derived from content, not from the label, and plausibly correlated with negative satisfaction. Legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "pos_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Count of positive lexicon words; independent of the label and carries signal about polarity. Valid predictor."},
    {"name": "neg_phrase_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Count of negative multi-word phrases; a text-derived feature that plausibly signals dissatisfaction without restating the label."},
    {"name": "negated_pos_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Counts negated positive expressions (e.g., 'not good'), a nuanced text feature that captures polarity flips; legitimate and non-trivial predictor."},
    {"name": "intensified_neg_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Counts intensified negatives (e.g., 'very bad'); text-derived, plausibly predictive of stronger dissatisfaction, not a restatement of label."},
    {"name": "sentiment_ratio", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Continuous net-sentiment score computed from text lexicon; an external feature that correlates with, but does not deterministically define, the label. Valid predictor (mild proxy risk but still a computed feature, not the label)."},
    {"name": "exclamation_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Stylistic feature (exclamation marks) that can carry emotional-intensity signal; independent of label. Weak but legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "caps_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "All-caps word count captures emphasis/emotion; a style feature outside the label that may carry signal. Legitimate."},
    {"name": "question_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Count of questions may reflect confusion/complaint; a text-style feature independent of the label. Weak but legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "short_title_flag", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Title-length flag; a structural feature outside the label with possible weak signal. Legitimate though weak."},
    {"name": "composite_neg_score", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Aggregate of the other negativity signals; a computed feature from text, not the label. It is somewhat redundant with its components but still a valid predictor, not leakage."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 11,
  "predictive_utility": 0.75,
  "rationale": "All added columns are computed from the review text/title (content, title), not from label_pos, so none leak or restate the focus. The set goes well beyond mechanical length/token counts: it includes polarity lexicons, negation handling, intensification, and net-sentiment ratio, which are genuinely predictive of satisfaction. There is notable internal redundancy (composite_neg_score aggregates several others; neg/pos counts overlap with sentiment_ratio), and some style features (exclamation, caps, questions, short-title) are weak, so incremental leverage is high but not maximal. sentiment_ratio approaches a proxy for the label but remains a computed feature rather than a component of it. Strong, coherent predictive feature set."
}
